title: Concept: Superset console is reachable without authentication
description: Superset connects to the warehouse with stored credentials and exposes SQL Lab to anyone who signs in. An unauthenticated shell shows the instance was deployed without its authentication story finished, and the default admin credentials are the usual next guess.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reads dashboards and, once signed in, runs SQL against the warehouse with the service account Superset holds.
